instruction: Use SKILL.md with the scenario. Return the intended action, CLI subcommand or direct tool, what must be checked, and what must not be assumed. Do not perform side effects.

cases.request: Fix a typo in one local note in this current conversation; no job or delegation needed.
Implement an API change with independent review, a recovery path, and durable progress across sessions.
Store this full objective as a new Relay Job, but do not start planning or executing.
I have a legacy Relay Job that was previously bound to a GitHub PR. Show its current durable status and preserve its history.
Coordinate a durable local-only file workflow without GitHub authentication.
Create a vlog that requires the human to approve a script before editing and publication.
Add a durable child Task to implement and independently validate login recovery.
A worker sent task.completed, but I want to know whether the Task actually succeeded.
Reviewer found defects in the immutable PR head. It completed the review normally.
The worker process exited, no correlated terminal event is accepted, and the outcome is unknown.
Troubleshoot a failed Relay Task with duplicate and out-of-order progress events.
A Troubleshooter confirms the only remaining blocker is user authorization to access a service.
Browser UI readiness fails but there is no evidence of an authentication failure.
A managed Task Prompt specifies a Skill at a specific path and hash, but a newer global CLI is on PATH.
The Planner has a stale execution identity and its proposed JSON seems complete.
Diagnose why the Agents Relay daemon is offline and verify its service registration.
Planner has an accepted candidate Plan and the exact apply_cli command provided in the current plan context. What must happen before a successful final receipt?
The execution-bound plan apply CLI returns PLAN_APPLY_VALIDATION_FAILED with phase candidate and two issues. The execution is still current. Decide the next action.
A Planner command may have applied a Plan, but its receipt was lost. The model cannot verify durable state.
The Reviewer completed its assessment of an immutable head SHA and found acceptance failures. How should it report the result?
The Reviewer tried the available authoritative evidence and still cannot identify the immutable reviewed PR head SHA; there is no valid review result to report.
A worker has just received a correlated Task context and wants to begin work, then report completion once file output is durable.
A stale Task execution sends task.completed for a job whose active Task now has a different execution ID.
After inspecting complete failure history, the Troubleshooter has fixed and verified the failing original Task's blocker and needs to authorize retry.
A human answered the authorization request attached to a BLOCKED Troubleshooter. The original Task is still FAILED.
Two failed tasks depend on one common broken runtime launcher; the fix is not available within this recovery execution.
Create one new durable Task with an explicit dependency on an unfinished prerequisite. Specify the dependency rather than starting that Task now.
An existing Neo Project has a customized Agent Graph requiring consent before media publication; do not apply a universal stage order.
A user asks for an explanation of Agent Relay only; they have not asked to start a Job or modify their system.

You are the Relay Planner for a Spec-oriented deliverable. The feature is already specified; the target checkout has valid .specify/ and spec.md. The current Plan is active. What Spec Kit sub-Skill must guide planning before applying the execution-bound Relay Plan?

Your assigned Relay implementation Task implements only the treasure clue response. This is a Spec-oriented delivery with valid .specify/plan.md/tasks.md. Other Relay Tasks own reveal and rewards. The speckit-implement workflow is whole-feature only. Which workflow do you follow, and why should you not invoke speckit-implement for this subset?

You are the immutable-head Relay Reviewer of a Spec-oriented deliverable. The assigned review includes requirements consistency across spec.md, plan.md and tasks.md, all present in the checkout. Which read-only Spec Kit sub-Skill should guide consistency analysis, while preserving independent immutable-head review?

You are recovering a failed Relay Task. Verified evidence proves the implementation omitted one Spec requirement. In the assigned editable checkout, speckit-tasks and speckit-implement have completed and the Task explicitly authorizes adding convergence entries to tasks.md. Which relevant Spec Kit sub-Skill can guide convergence before Relay recovery?
forbidden: declare relay task complete from tasks.md

cases.request: You are the Relay Planner for an ordinary operational incident without any .specify/ project, spec.md or spec-oriented deliverable. Plan the next durable investigation Task. Select the authoritative workflow and avoid unnecessary Spec Kit stages.

A single assigned Relay implementation Task explicitly owns all work in one Spec Kit feature. The feature has complete spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md and valid .specify prerequisites; no sibling Relay Tasks own any part. Which Spec Kit sub-Skill should execute the entire feature?
